body: Two Philippine Air Force SF-260 trainer aircraft crashed during a training flight at Fernando Air Base in Batangas province, south of Manila, on Friday, killing four pilots, the military said on Saturday. The aircraft crashed within the grounds of the air base, and there were no other casualties. Local media reported that the two planes collided in midair, though the Air Force statement did not confirm a collision.

The Air Force has temporarily grounded its fleet of SF-260 trainer planes pending an investigation into the cause of the accident. In May, two pilots were killed when an SF-260 trainer aircraft crashed in a mountainous area in northern Philippines, and an SF-260 TP Marchetti crashed during a 2023 training flight, also killing two pilots.
en.summary: Two Philippine Air Force SF-260 trainer aircraft crashed during a training flight at Fernando Air Base south of Manila, killing four pilots. The Air Force has temporarily grounded its SF-260 fleet pending an investigation.
en.title: Four Philippine Air Force pilots killed as two SF-260 trainers crash during training flight

body: 菲律賓空軍兩架SF-260教練機於10月23日星期五，在馬尼拉以南八打雁省費爾南多空軍基地進行訓練飛行時墜毀，機上4名飛行員罹難。菲律賓空軍在聲明中表示，兩機墜落在基地範圍內，除機上人員外沒有其他傷亡；當地媒體報導兩機在空中相撞，但空軍聲明未證實相撞說法。
空軍已暫時停飛SF-260教練機機隊，等待事故原因調查。今年5月，另有一架SF-260教練機在菲律賓北部山區墜毀，造成2名飛行員罹難；2023年也曾發生SF-260TP教練機訓練飛行墜毀事故，同樣造成2名飛行員罹難。
zh.summary: 菲律賓空軍兩架SF-260教練機在馬尼拉以南的費爾南多空軍基地訓練飛行時墜毀，4名飛行員罹難；空軍已暫時停飛SF-260機隊等待調查。
zh.title: 菲律賓空軍兩架SF-260教練機訓練中墜毀4名飛行員罹難
